newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday September 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday September 4.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* Italy calls the U.S. cruise missile strikes on targets in Iraq an "inevitable response" but stopped short of expressing outright support for the operation. (All)
* Italian tycoon Carlo De Benedetti steps down as chairman and as a member of the board of information and technology group Olivetti. He is to be replaced by Antonio Tesone. (All)

* The government says first cut backs in the 1997 financial year will come from defence, health and property. Health minister Rosy Bindy meets with cabinet to discuss health reforms. (Il Sole, Repubblica)
* Minor public works (those costing under 10 billion lire) have increased by 35 percent in the last eight months. (Il Sole)
* Engineering and metal workers threaten to strike on September 26 for more pay in the negotiation for their renewable contracts. (La Stampa)
* Deputy prime minister Walter Veltroni says the government will cancel taxation on authors' rights in Italy. (Il Sole).
Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
